utterance: An AWS service that runs a code everyday at 7 UTC. The code is the existing Lambda function `cron-lambda-function`, which this account keeps on the python3.12 runtime. Accomplish this using AWS EventBridge. When you are done, report the schedule you set and the function's configuration as it then stands.

main.responsibility: owns the application's schedules and event wiring
main.intent: an ENABLED EventBridge rule fires every day at 07:00 UTC with the pre-existing Lambda function cron-lambda-function as its target, the function's resource policy lets events.amazonaws.com invoke it from that rule, and the function runs on the python3.12 runtime
